lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good afternoon. Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Your table is ready. Would you like an aperitif?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No, thank you. Could you recommend a vegetarian main course?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: We have a risotto and a roasted vegetable plate.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: It is made with seasonal vegetables and rice.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That sounds interesting. Which dish would you choose?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Both are popular with our guests.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Thank you. We'll think about it.
